description_en: Submits a batch job to render multiple videos by providing a list of editing project IDs
description_zh: 输入多个剪辑工程ID，批量提交时间线合成，生成多个视频
name: SubmitSceneBatchEditingJob

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of editing project IDs. The video is rendered based on the timeline from each project
parameters.help_zh: 剪辑工程ID列表，用来获取时间线并合成成片。多值用英文逗号隔开
parameters.name: project_ids

parameters.help_en: The output configuration. The structure is the same as the OutputConfig (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/use-cases/create-highlight-videos?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-193643.d_3_2_0_3.3af86997GreVu9\&scm=20140722.H_2863940._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1#4111a373d0xbz) for batch video generation, except that Count and GeneratePreviewOnly are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 输出配置。除不支持配置Count和GeneratePreviewOnly外，其他参数和一键成片OutputConfig (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/use-cases/create-highlight-videos?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-193643.d_3_2_0_3.3af86997GreVu9&scm=20140722.H_2863940._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1#4111a373d0xbz)配置相同
parameters.name: output_config

parameters.help_en: Custom user data, including callback configurations. For more information, see [UserData](~~357745#section-urj-v3f-0s1~~)
parameters.help_zh: 用户业务配置、回调配置。具体结构定义，请参见[UserData配置说明](~~357745#section-urj-v3f-0s1~~)
parameters.name: user_data
